text:
mira_cs: Quick sync for Cohort Zero onboarding next Tue — two things I need help with:

mira_cs: 1) SSO still failing for 3 seats (TokenMismatch). Need someone from infra to triage before the enablement.

mira_cs: 2) We want a 2-minute feedback capture to send right after each demo that maps to renewal risk tags (low/med/high) so AE can escalate. Thoughts on wording?

oliver_pm: Noted. Who are the three customers with SSO issues?

mira_cs: jlee@acme (ACME), tara_s@novus (Novus), veridian-ops (Veridian). Error snippet below: 

```
Error: TokenMismatch: expected header 'x-redirect' missing
RequestID: abcd-1234
Path: /auth/sso/callback
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0
```

ella_cs: I can hop on a quick SSO debug call tomorrow 10:00am PT. @devops-bot can you open an infra ticket and tag sso-team? :pray:

devops-bot: Created ticket #CS-6623 and assigned to infra/sso. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6623

mira_cs: thanks! For feedback capture — rough proposal: 3 quick Qs (single-click where possible)
mira_cs: Q1: Did the demo show the core value you expected? (Yes / No)
mira_cs: Q2: Biggest blocker to integrating Redwood in pilot (SSO / API / Cost / Other)
mira_cs: Q3: Renewal likelihood at pilot end (Low / Medium / High)

ben_eng: For Q2 add an "integration clinic" CTA so we can auto-offer followup if they pick SSO or API. Also prefer Q3 wording: "How likely are you to renew at the end of the pilot?" with a 1-5 scale.

oliver_pm: Agree with Ben. My plan: run 2x30m sessions — Quickstart (core flows) + Integration clinic (SSO/API breakouts). SSO folks go to breakout.

mira_cs: sounds good. I'll update the invite and include the one-click survey link. Can ops-analytics add an event to flag any "Low" or "1-2" responses as renewal risk?

ops-analytics: yes — adding cohort_zero.post_demo_survey with property renewal_risk. We'll trigger AE alert on renewal_risk: low within 24h.

ella_cs: I'll join the SSO call and triage logs. If infra needs sample user creds I can share.

mira_cs: perfect. Owners: SSO triage = infra/sso via CS-6623, Survey template = mira_cs + ben_eng, Enablement split = oliver_pm.

mira_cs: I'll post a calendar invite + survey link by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
